meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Ula'tek
encounter.description: The great shame of the Amani empire. The vast complex of Altal'Utek was created to imprison the weapon that proved to be as much of a threat as the enemy she was intended to destroy. Ula'tek has risen from her ancient slumber and threatens all of Azeroth if she should escape.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
Ula'tek splashes venom across her platform with [Caustic Waves]. Any Blightscale Spawn that touch her venom hatches and covers players in a [Putrid Membrane]. While her slithering children continue to spawn, Ula'tek uses her [Spectral Coils] to shatter the space.

After Ula'tek rails against her prison with [Rage of the Shackled] she summons her faithful then dives beneath the venom to gather her strength. Ula'tek's Doomscale Wardens move between the Blightscale Spawn imbuing them with [Writhing Gestation] as the Doomscale Eggs begin to hatch.

With her progeny broken, Ula'tek shatters the arena. She continues to use [Call of the Serpent] to gather her forces while destroying the only safe spaces remaining with [Circling Prey].

abilities.title: Malignant Shell
abilities.description: Ula'tek's eggs are covered in a viscous shell that sticks to players who touch them, inflicting 100009 Nature damage every 1 sec while attached.

abilities.title: Putrid Membrane
abilities.description: When Ula'teks eggs hatch a Blightscale Viper, they spray a membrane over all players that inflicts 33336 Nature damage every 1 sec for 1 hour.

abilities.title: Poisonous Bite
abilities.description: The Blightscale Rawling's bite inflicts 25002 Nature damage every 1 sec to their current target for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Acidic Burst
abilities.description: The viper spits at a random player, inflicting 375033 Nature damage on impact and an additional 58338 Nature damage every 1 sec for 18 sec.

abilities.title: Petrifying Sting
abilities.description: The Viper dives at a random player, turning players within 10 yards of the location to stone, absorbing the next 2131475 healing and inflicting 100009 Nature damage every 2 sec.

abilities.title: Hardened
abilities.description:
The shell of the Blightscale Spawn absorbs the next 4618195 damage.

While the spawn's shell is hardened, it cannot be moved.

abilities.title: Noxious Shell
abilities.description:
Ula'tek's noxious eggs inflict 133345 Nature damage every 1 sec while attached to a player.

Moving within 3 yards of another player carrying a Noxious Shell causes a Noxious Splash.

When the aura is removed, the egg inflicts Rancid Yolk on the player.

abilities.title: Noxious Splash
abilities.description: Moving within 3 yards of another player carrying a Noxious Shell causes it to instantly hatch and inflicts 750066 Nature damage and an additional 541714 Nature damage every 1 sec to the carrier for 10 sec.

abilities.title: Rancid Yolk
abilities.description: The egg breaks, spilling Rancid Yolk over the player and increasing the damage inflicted from Noxious Shell by 200% for 20 sec.

abilities.title: Boiling Venom
abilities.description: After 25 sec the Blightscale's venom boils, increasing its haste by 100% and all damage done by 100%.

abilities.title: Acidic Expulsion
abilities.description: The Blightscale expulses venom, inflicting 125011 Nature damage on impact and an additional 25002 Nature damage every 1 sec to all players for 35 sec.

abilities.title: Toxic Womb
abilities.description:
Ula'tek rips a gestating Blightscale Wretch from the ceiling that inflicts 916747 Nature damage to players within 7 yards of the impact location. 

Torn from its incubation, the Blightscale Wretch will awaken after 20 sec.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Boiling Venom
abilities.description: After 30 sec the Blightscale's venom boils, increasing its haste by 100% and all damage done by 100%.

abilities.title: Fester Burst
abilities.description: The Blightscale Wretch forms a festering membrane around itself which bursts, inflicting 541714 Nature damage on impact and an additional 100009 Nature damage every 1 sec to players farther than 10 yards away for 12 sec.

abilities.title: Toxic Incubation
abilities.description:
A spectral Ula'tek unleashes a cascade of venom towards the Blightscale Wretch, applying Mother's Boon every 1 sec for 4 sec. If a player intercepts the venom, it inflicts 625055 Nature damage and applies Toxic Burn to them instead.

Each impact causes Caustic Waves to erupt from the target's location.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Mother's Boon
abilities.description: Each application of Mother's Boon the Blightscale Wretch receives reduces their damage taken by 10% and increases their damage done by 15%. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Toxic Burn
abilities.description: The player's skin sizzles, inflicting 291692 Nature damage every 2 sec for12 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Caustic Waves
abilities.description:
Ula'tek sends waves of venom across the platform, inflicting 917189 Nature damage on impact and an additional 540199 Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to players in their path. This effect stacks.

Waves that connect with Ula'tek's eggs cause them to instantly hatch.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Call of the Serpent
abilities.description: Ula'tek roars, causing her spawn to fall from the ceiling and inflict 916747 Nature damage to players within 4 yards of their impact locations.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Mother's Wrath
abilities.description:
Ula'tek knocks back her current target, marking them for wrath, inflicting 375033 Nature damage every 5.2 sec for 3 sec while within reach of her attack. Each bite injects Ula'tek's target with Stone Venom and leaves them Hobbled.

If her current target is outside her reach, Ula'tek inflicts these effects on all players.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Stone Venom
abilities.description: Ula'tek's venom inflicts 41670 Nature damage every 1 sec for 1.7 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Hobbled
abilities.description: Ula'tek hobbles her current target, reducing their movement speed by 55% for 1 min.

abilities.title: Rattler Slam
abilities.description: While not in melee combat, Ula'tek's tail slams the platform, inflicting 916747 Nature damage to all players.

abilities.title: Mephitic Thrash
abilities.description: Ula'tek's tail sweeps the ground, inflicting 750066 Nature damage to players within 35 yards and knocking them back. In addition, players outside 35 yards are inflicted with 625055 Nature damage and an additional 200018 Nature damage every 2 sec for 10 sec.

abilities.title: Spectral Coils
abilities.description: Ula'tek's Spectral Coils rise above the platform and crush anything beneath them, inflicting 916747 Nature damage to all players. This damage is reduced by the number of players within 10 yards of the impact location.

abilities.title: Soul Constrictor
abilities.description: Ula'tek constricts your soul, preventing you from mitigating damage from Spectral Coils for 5 sec.

abilities.title: Necrotic Vapors
abilities.description: As Ula'tek disturbs the pool, Necrotic Vapors fill the room, inflicting 54171 Nature damage every 1 sec to all players. This effect stacks.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Ula'tek's Bond
abilities.description: All aspects of Ula'tek's form share damage taken.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Rage of the Shackled
abilities.description:
Ula'tek rages, inflicting 500044 Nature damage every 4 sec to all players for 20 sec and causing Falling Debris to impact several random destinations.

Flying into this rage exposes Ula'tek's Venomous Heart.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Falling Debris
abilities.description: Falling debris drops onto several random destinations, inflicting 2500220 Nature damage to players within 7 yards of the impact locations.

abilities.title: Venomous Heart
abilities.description: The beating core of Ula'tek. All damage taken by the Venomous Heart is increased by 100% for 20 sec.

abilities.title: Unchecked Rage
abilities.description: If Ula'tek is unable to melee a nearby player when she is not casting or channeling, she inflicts Physical damage to all players.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

abilities.title: Mass Gestation
abilities.description: Disturbing a Doomscale Egg invokes all remaining Blightscale Spawn on their side to begin Writhing Gestation.

abilities.title: Hatching Doom
abilities.description: The Ravenous Doomscale smells prey, clawing at its egg so it can hatch and feed.

abilities.title: Doomscale Shell
abilities.description:
Ula'tek's Doomscale Eggs are covered in a viscous shell that sticks to players that touch them, inflicting 100009 Nature damage every 2 sec while it is attached.

After picked up, the beast within hatches after 20 sec.

abilities.title: Dread Roar
abilities.description: The Ravenous Doomscale roars, inflicting 791736 Nature damage every 1 sec and stunning all players for 20 sec.

abilities.title: Defect: Weakened
abilities.description: Disrupting the Ravenous Doomscale's gestation weakens it, increasing all its damage taken by 100%. In this weakened state, the beast also cannot use Dread Roar.

abilities.title: Anguished Cry
abilities.description: The Weakened Doomscale screams in agony, inflicting 541714 Nature damage to players within 60 yards and stuns them for 6 sec.

abilities.title: Desperate Thrash
abilities.description: The Weakened Doomscale thrashes, inflicting 541714 Nature damage on impact and an additional 58338 Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the cone for 6 sec.

abilities.title: Revenge
abilities.description: With the death of their clutchmate, the Weakened Doomscale flies into a rage, increasing their haste by 100% and all their damage done by 100%.

abilities.title: Grasping Fangs
abilities.description:
The Doomscale Warden sinks fangs into random players, inflicting 166681 Nature damage every 2 sec and reduces their movement speed by 45% while the Grasping Fangs are unbroken.

Snapping the fang inflicts Blight Vein.

abilities.title: Blight Vein
abilities.description: Blight Vein is injected into the player on the removal of Grasping Fangs, inflicting 291692 Nature damage every 2 sec for 8 sec.

abilities.title: Warden's Protection
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden's life force coils around the eggs, inflicting 291692 Nature damage every 1 sec to players within 7 yards and forbidding all touch while the warden draws breath.

abilities.title: Malice
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden unleashes malice, inflicting 791736 Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.title: Shadow Molt
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden sheds its shadow skin and slithers to a new destination.

abilities.title: Writhing Gestation
abilities.description: The Doomscale Warden transforms nearby Blightscale Spawn into a Blightscale Clutch that hatches after 20 sec.

abilities.title: Blight Vein
abilities.description: Blight Vein is injected into all players on the removal of Grasping Fangs, inflicting 216686 Nature damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Doomscale Cauldron
abilities.description: A hissing cauldron of corrosive venom ready to devour any offering thrown into its depths.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage Two: Children of the Doomscale

abilities.title: Blightscale Clutch
abilities.description: Ula'tek's spawn within the clutch grow in power during Writhing Gestation while it remains unbroken.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage Two: Children of the Doomscale

abilities.title: Virulent Spit
abilities.description: Ula'tek spits venom at several destinations, inflicting 918489 Nature damage to players within 4 yards of the impact locations.
abilities.parentTitle: Stage Two: Children of the Doomscale

abilities.title: Circling Prey
abilities.description: Ula'tek destroys a portion of the platform, drawing her prey closer and inflicting 2500220 Nature damage and knocking back players within 13 yards. Additionally, players outside 13 yards are inflicted with 625055 Nature damage.

abilities.title: Call of the Serpent
abilities.description: Ula'tek roars, shaking her children from the ceiling and causing them to fall.

abilities.title: Vicious Echoes
abilities.description: The Blightscale Shrieker screams, inflicting 625055 Nature damage to players and an additional 133345 Nature damage every 1 sec and stunning them for 6 sec.

abilities.title: Serpent's Bite
abilities.description:
Ula'tek shoots fangs into several players, applying a venom that inflicts 416703 Nature damage on impact and an additional 100009 Nature damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. Upon expiration, the player is turned into a Calcified Corpse.

Players within 7 yards may leech the venom to remove it but become infected with Volatile Purge.

abilities.title: Calcified Corpse
abilities.description: Ula'tek's venom turns the player to stone, stunning them and inflicting 1000088 Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect pierces immunities.

abilities.title: Volatile Purge
abilities.description:
Players that leech Serpent's Bite purge their venom after 5 sec. On expiration, the poison erupts from the affected players, inflicting 625055 Nature damage on impact and an additional 41670 Nature damage every 1 sec for 18 sec to players near the purge. This effect stacks.

In addition, Volatile Purge increases damage taken from Deadly Venom by 25%.

abilities.title: Calcified Corpse
abilities.description:
Ula'tek's venom turns the player to stone, stunning them and inflicting 1000088 Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect pierces immunities.

In addition, the Calcified Corpse radiates toxins inflicting 1250110 Nature damage every 1 sec to players.

abilities.title: Fury Unleashed
abilities.description: Ula'tek tears her prison asunder, inflicting 2500220 Nature to all players immediately, then an additional 916747 Nature damage every 1 sec.
